$comment: KPI baselines = current-state operations, used to compute improvement %. Each baseline cites a source. Where a public NLDS / jnport.gov.in figure exists it is cited; otherwise the value is ASSUMED-WITH-JUSTIFICATION and cross-referenced in docs/ASSUMPTIONS.md (prompt §8). DO NOT treat ASSUMED values as JNPA-confirmed — they are placeholders an evaluator can override in this file without code change.

rakeTurnaroundTime.scope: per rake siding cycle (arrival -> departure), T1/T2 mean
rakeTurnaroundTime.justification: Indian Railways CTO siding cycle norms 6–10 hr; midpoint used pending JNPA FOIS extract. See ASSUMPTIONS.md#rake-tat-baseline

interTerminalTransferTat.scope: ITRHO request-out -> in, mean across road+rail moves
interTerminalTransferTat.justification: Inter-terminal trans-shipment trailer cycle estimate pending ITRHO log extract. See ASSUMPTIONS.md#itrho-baseline

trailerTurnaroundTime.scope: gate-in -> gate-out for a trailer port visit, mean
trailerTurnaroundTime.justification: Road trailer port-visit dwell estimate; targets sub-3hr post-twin. See ASSUMPTIONS.md#trailer-tat-baseline

scannerTurnaroundTime.scope: scan queue-in -> clear, mean over flagged containers
scannerTurnaroundTime.justification: Customs scan queue + exam cycle estimate. See ASSUMPTIONS.md#scanner-tat-baseline

transshipmentTrailerTat.scope: trailer TAT filtered to originStream=TRANSSHIP / ITRHO road moves
transshipmentTrailerTat.justification: Trans-shipment trailer cycle estimate. See ASSUMPTIONS.md#transship-trailer-baseline

bufferPendency.scope: containers in CFS/buffer beyond dwell threshold, port-wide snapshot
bufferPendency.justification: Typical CFS buffer pendency snapshot pending facility pendency extract. See ASSUMPTIONS.md#buffer-pendency-baseline

mixedTrainOptimization.scope: baseline mean containers per rake (mixed + dedicated)
mixedTrainOptimization.justification: BLCA/BLC rake nominal 90-TEU capacity at ~85% utilisation. See ASSUMPTIONS.md#mixed-train-baseline

gateTransactionTime.scope: avg gate transaction time (arrival -> cleared), dashboard rollup
gateTransactionTime.justification: Pre-automation gate transaction estimate; target sub-5min at 100% automation. See ASSUMPTIONS.md#gate-txn-baseline
